about: Part of the reference catalogue: designed experiments from one published source, for testing that software reproduces them.
source: the citation, with what was read and when. experiments: each with its data (factors, responses, runs
exactly as printed, in the printed order), where it is printed, and expected: every number the source prints for
it, as printed text, with what it is, where it is printed (a line or page, and a quotation) and check: how to
recompute it (the kind of result, the term, the model in the library's formula notation, and runs, the 1-based
positions of the runs used when not all), or manual, the reason it is not recomputed. designs: designs without
responses, with the properties the source states. Read with process_improve.experiments.reference_catalogue.
reference_experiments; tests/test_reference_catalogue.py recomputes every number that has a check.
